source: 铸算华夏纪_团队合并工程_规范整理与交互修复_完整工程.zip
approach: Conserve merged backend/circuit framework; replace only quest-book visuals and test quest data.

quest_book: new 1898x829 horizontal artwork no baked ornament
changes.chapter_data: One test map named 地图, one 主线任务 and one 支线任务, two steps 步骤一/步骤二 per task, undeveloped chapters empty.
changes.persistence: Forward-only task transitions checked by server/database, real circuit pass required for main completion; test-only side steps; no fictional rewards.
changes.test_db: Former trial database replaced by clean test.sqlite3, no accounts/progress/scores/rewards, 4 official circuit snapshots.
changes.visual_actor: Rectangular hero/NPC/portrait placeholders; existing image assets retained.
changes.test_fixtures: Legacy random demo module removed from public; old empty chapter plugins archived.

known_limitations: Fonts intentionally absent; add user fonts later.
Go button and future chapter business remain placeholders.
Side steps test transitions only; real step conditions not implemented.
Browser QA uses mocked save calls, not a logged-in server/browser end-to-end run.

results_visual_merge.baseline: 铸算华夏纪_V2_任务书融合与任务状态规范_完整工程.zip
results_visual_merge.scope: Only leaderboard and personal results visual layout and two necessary PNG assets.
results_visual_merge.achievement_view: Unchanged from V2; no incoming achievement sprites, SVGs or demo data imported.
results_visual_merge.ranking_status: UI-only placeholder; no leaderboard data endpoint or fabricated ranking.
results_visual_merge.score_status: Uses original GET /api/circuit/results/mine and existing record field mapping.
results_visual_merge.checks: 100 Python tests + 10 Node/asset checks passed; Chromium responsive screenshots and back actions passed.
results_visual_merge.known_limitation: Ranking backend not implemented. Fonts remain to be provided by the team.

v2_3_map_bag.base: 铸算华夏纪_V2_2_行囊与地图功能接入_完整工程.zip

map.mode: Fullscreen scene, old map UI removed
map.camera: aspect-preserving overscanned image with bounded X/Y camera
map.hotspots: scene image coordinates, moving together with artwork
map.navigation: main -> world -> chapter -> room; camera cleaned up on leaving

inventory.overflow: add real inventory items and scroll within panel

v2_3_map_bag.validation: 100 Python tests, Node smoke tests and offline Chromium at 7 viewport sizes
v2_3_map_bag.limitation: Browser layout tests used real code/assets but mocked save callbacks

v2_4_ui_refinement.map_topbar: restored shared page title/brand bar; map viewport begins immediately below the 48px desktop / 44px mobile topbar

inventory_outer_board.source_assets: original decorative landscape and portrait inventory boards from user-provided assets archive

v2_4_ui_refinement.category_tabs: positioned so their lower edge touches the inner panel top edge
v2_4_ui_refinement.grid: CSS auto-fill recalculates columns from available inner-panel width; row count follows inventory length and scrolls within inner panel
v2_4_ui_refinement.visual_qa: CSS and source geometry checked; headless browser screenshot unavailable in this runtime, so final visual confirmation should be made in local browser

bag.inner_panel: inset parchment, separate sibling of category strip

map.header: same room-topbar DOM and CSS as room
map.keyboard: requestAnimationFrame at 360px/sec; normalized diagonal; stop on key release, blur and dispose

v2_5_layout_and_navigation.visual_qa_note: Chromium tested real layout CSS, original image assets and pannable map engine in an isolated DOM harness; not logged-in HTTP E2E

bag.tab_style: edge texture matched to inset parchment; no first-row overlap

v2_6_navigation_results.browser_qa: Isolated DOM running real CSS and extracted application functions, map engine, existing PNGs; not authenticated full HTTP flow

artwork.mobile_strategy: nine-slice stretch of frame borders; content remains scroll-safe

layout.empty_state: 静候揭榜；排行榜功能尚未开放

v2_12_phoenix_leaderboard.verification: 104 Python tests, 11 Node suites and asset audit pass; 8 responsive Chromium cases
v2_12_phoenix_leaderboard.limits: Browser layout tests used actual JS view functions, CSS and artwork in isolated DOM; not an authenticated backend E2E.
